visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown styled hair wearing a beige hooded jacket and a maroon sweater stands on a busy urban street corner. He holds a black coffee cup and speaks with animated facial expressions, including squinting eyes and a furrowed brow, while gesturing with his free hand. Behind him, pedestrians in winter clothing walk past a green traffic light and city buildings under an overcast sky. (2) The scene shifts to the man standing inside a traditional temple setting with red pillars and ornate decorations. He points his finger at a large yellow and pink chart displayed on a glass partition, which features cartoon illustrations of a green snake and a pink pig alongside columns of numbers. He appears surprised, opening his mouth wide and looking directly at the camera. (3) A close-up shot shows the man sitting at a wooden desk, leaning over a pink paper form. He holds a pen and hesitates, looking confused while attempting to write. Various stacks of pink and white forms are visible on the table, along with his coffee cup. (4) The man interacts with temple staff members wearing masks and blue uniforms. He receives a white slip of paper and later stands at a service counter protected by a transparent acrylic shield. He pulls out his wallet, counts bills, and hands them to a person behind the counter. (5) The man walks through a red-pillared corridor of the temple, holding his pink registration slip. He stops at a small window and peeks inside, speaking to someone through the opening. The camera captures a close-up of a red ledger book on a desk inside the booth, with black calligraphy text visible on the pages. (6) In the final phase, the man stands in a courtyard area of the temple with stone carvings and trees in the background. He looks relieved and smiles broadly at the camera, bowing slightly and waving as he concludes his activity.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a fast pace. He describes personal misfortunes over an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic guitar BGM with a steady 4/4 drum beat. Background city traffic noise is faintly audible. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect occurs as the speaker highlights a specific point about bad luck. The vocal pitch rises as he expresses concern about the 'zodiac year' effect. (3) The acoustic BGM continues seamlessly as the scene transitions indoors. The man's voice becomes more conversational while interacting with others. The sound of paper rustling is captured when he handles forms. A 'pop' bubble SFX emphasizes a humorous moment regarding his inability to write certain characters. (4) Laughter from a female speaker is heard in the background. The main speaker's intensity remains moderate but animated. The sound of a pen clicking and coins or bills being handled at a counter is audible beneath the narration. (5) As he peeks through a window, his voice drops slightly in volume but maintains clarity. A cartoonish 'slide whistle' or comical SFX accompanies his confused reaction to temple procedures. The BGM maintains its consistent, bright energy throughout the dialogue with temple staff. (6) The video concludes with the man speaking in a cheerful, relieved tone in the temple courtyard. The music swells slightly in volume during the final wave, ending with a clean hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook (Bad Luck) -> Action (Temple Visit) -> Process (Registration/Payment) -> Resolution (Peace of Mind).
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share the cultural experience of 'An Tai Sui' (appeasing the zodiac deity) at Longshan Temple in Taipei. The creator uses a humorous, personal vlog style to explain the process, including his own confusion and interactions with temple staff, ultimately conveying a message of seeking spiritual comfort and good fortune for the year.
